label: Terrazzo · cement (light grey/cream, marble + recycled-glass chips)

source.selection_reason: IMG_8943 is a real FloorDSGN installed cement-terrazzo floor, shot near-top-down at 4032x3024 (12 MP) with even diffuse lighting. Authentic owner work, high enough resolution to crop a 2048 master, and shows the true light-grey cement matrix with fine marble + recycled-glass chips. The web product swatches (vitra/kartinkin) were sharper but small (768x384 / 2048x1536) and read as decorative resin terrazzo rather than the grey cement product this slug represents.
source.crop_reason: Upper band ABOVE the floor control-joint line; flattest face-on patch with the most even chip distribution and no grout seam.
source.rejected_set: The 'Фил Фото пардес хана' DSC08xxx set (6000x4000, very flat light) was rejected for THIS slug — it is smooth grey microcement / decorative-concrete with no chips, shot oblique with shallow depth-of-field. Better suited to microtopping/decorative-concrete.

material_truth.fillers: Marble / natural-stone chips ~4-12 mm plus recycled-glass aggregate (visible green + amber + black chips) set in a Portland-cement matrix. Fine quartz sand fills the inter-chip matrix.
material_truth.matrix: Light warm-grey cement (CEM I + polymer additives).
material_truth.finish: Ground + sealed, matte-to-satin (lithium-silicate / waxed seal). Not high-gloss.
material_truth.manufacturer_recipe: Sika Sikafloor Terrazzo CS-31 — mineral cement terrazzo, 12-18 mm body over Sika Primer-3N on C25/30 concrete; marble crushed aggregate 4-12 mm; sealed topcoat. Matches the manifest buildup already on file.

colour.note: Matrix hex sampled from light pixels (luma>150) of the de-lit albedo, excluding dark chips. Warm light-grey — markedly more honest than the current manifest swatch #efe7d6 (near-white).

scale.physical_mm_per_tile: ~300-360 mm represented by the 2048px master (chips read ~4-12 mm at this crop).
scale.tile_note: Manifest 'tile' is an integer repeat across the plate, not mm. Current value 3 is correct; 3-4 keeps chips at a realistic 4-12 mm read on a ~600 mm plate. Do NOT drop to 1 (chips would look oversized).

gloss.note: Matte-ish ground+sealed terrazzo. roughness.png mean anchored to 0.50.

processing.decode: sips HEIC->PNG, crop 1330px square, lanczos3 upscale to 2048 (UPSCALED from 1330px source).
processing.delight: sharp divide-by-heavy-blur (sigma=256, blurDiv 8) re-multiplied by channel means, strength 0.85 -> lighting-neutral albedo.
processing.seamless: 50% wrap-roll + offset-patch seam heal (raised-cosine feather, perpendicular clone offset 10% of width). Validated by 2x2 tiling.
processing.pbr: scripts/gen-pbr-maps.js terrazzo-cement --root=3d-assets/textures-v4 (bump 6.5, chipsSmooth true, ao 1.4); roughness then linear-shifted to mean 0.50.

caveats: Source master was UPSCALED from a 1330px crop to 2048px (lanczos3) — fine matrix grain is slightly soft at 1:1; fine at normal viewing/render distance.
Matrix is warm light-grey (#a3a298), not neutral grey — this is the true colour of the owner's CS-31 install. If a cooler/neutral grey is desired, the colour control in the configurator can shift it.
Chips include recycled-glass (green/amber) which is characteristic of this specific floor; if a pure marble-only look is wanted, the kartinkin product swatch is an alternate source on file.

recommended_manifest.palette_note: matrix light-grey, matrix mean, light chips, mid-grey chips, black chips, green recycled-glass, amber recycled-glass
recommended_manifest.note: Repoint pbr.* from textures/terrazzo-cement/* to textures-v4/terrazzo-cement/* to use this new set. (Orchestrator applies — do not edit manifest here.)
